Taylor has asked for the point-person arrangement to be reconsidered before the next transition milestone, and Casey is currently listed as the point person for client-transition questions. Before I make any decisions about the working arrangement going forward, I want to hear from everyone involved — Taylor, Casey, and HR — so we can get all the relevant facts on the table. Let's start with Taylor: could you walk us through your concerns and why you're asking for the arrangement to be reconsidered?
